methodology.displayName: Donation Redirect cancellation, redirection, and top-up model v1

estimandDefinitions.baseline_redirected: The verified amount of opposed or lower-priority planned spending that was canceled and completed at the frozen shared destination. This is redirected baseline money, not additional money.
estimandDefinitions.success_case_additional: Any genuinely new top-up or match amount that would be completed only if the redirect agreement succeeds, excluding both parties’ frozen original plans.
estimandDefinitions.expected_additional: The genuinely new top-up or match amount multiplied by the modeled probability that it completes because of the redirect agreement. Redirected baseline amounts are not included in this estimand.
estimandDefinitions.direct_causal_attribution: Participant-specific verified cancellation and redirection effect under the approved reciprocal-role model, reported as baseline redirected unless it is a genuinely new top-up. A dollar enters additive aggregates at most once.
estimandDefinitions.verified_additional: A genuinely new top-up or match amount verified at the frozen destination, net of refunds, reversals, duplicates, and any amount contained in either party’s original plan.

methodology.baselineDefinition: Before acceptance, freeze each party’s exact planned amount, original destination, timing, confidence and supporting evidence, the ratio or matching rule, shared destination, fallback if no match occurs, optional top-up, and settlement evidence. Preserve both original plans unless the exact redirect agreement completes.
methodology.algorithmDescription: Verify that both original plans predate acceptance and remain credible. On completion, report the canceled and rerouted original amounts as baseline redirected, never as new resources. Treat only frozen top-ups or matches absent from both baselines as success-case additional. Estimate completion and baseline credibility from resolved redirects. Attribute participant-specific reciprocal effects without double counting the same dollar across platform aggregates. Do not produce a value-adjusted claim without an independently approved conversion model.

referenceClassPolicy.uncertaintyExpansionRule: Increase uncertainty for baseline credibility and agreement completion at every broadening step. Withhold when either original plan or the shared destination cannot be verified.

uncertaintyPolicy.method: Use separate calibrated hierarchical models for original-plan credibility, matched cancellation, destination completion, and optional top-up completion; propagate them jointly by posterior simulation.
uncertaintyPolicy.confidencePolicy: Withhold when model health is blocked or stale. Label low confidence only after health passes and the eligible sample is at least 50; moderate requires at least 100 eligible resolved observations, no more than one approved reference-class broadening step, and no blocking calibration failure; high requires at least 200 observations, the narrowest approved class, empirical 80% coverage between 75% and 85%, calibration slope between 0.8 and 1.2, and no active warnings.

requiredCalibrationMetrics: Brier score for modeled completion or activation probability
blockedConditions: eligible resolved-observation count below the methodology minimum
80% interval empirical coverage outside the approved tolerance
required state is missing or does not match the immutable state hash
input is outside the approved domain
unresolved evidence-integrity, duplication, or overlap failure
either original plan lacks contemporaneous evidence
shared destination or exact amount cannot be verified
redirected baseline money would be labeled as additional
warningConditions: reference class broadened beyond the narrowest approved class
sample size below the high-confidence threshold
calibration drift within the warning band
material share of observations relies on participant attestation rather than independent evidence
original plans have materially unequal confidence
political or regulated donation rules require jurisdiction-specific review
destination value comparison is requested without an approved conversion model

sourceDataRequirements: immutable pre-acceptance original plans, amounts, destinations, timing, and confidence
matching ratio, shared destination, fallback, and optional top-up terms
cancellation or non-payment evidence for each original plan where available
exact shared-destination receipts or authenticated provider events
refund, reversal, default, and amendment history
stable deduplication keys across original, redirected, and top-up payments
knownFailureModes: one or both original plans were not genuine
opposed payments would not actually have affected opposing outcomes
participants complete both original and redirected payments
redirected baseline amounts are mislabeled as additional resources
the same redirected dollar is attributed to both participants in an additive aggregate
destination receipt does not prove cancellation of the original plan
value improvement is asserted without a defensible conversion model
outOfDomainConditions: original plan cannot be frozen or evidenced before acceptance
political, election, or regulated donation exchange lacks jurisdiction-specific legal approval
shared destination identity or receipt cannot be verified
currency conversion is required but no immutable conversion snapshot exists
agreement contains coercive threats or incentivizes creation of a harmful baseline
materialChangeTriggers: reference-class fields, broadening order, or minimum sample size changes
probability, uncertainty, or confidence method changes
new data source or evidence-quality tier
aggregation, overlap, or double-counting rule changes
new participant role or lifecycle state
change to plan credibility, matching ratio, cancellation, fallback, or top-up semantics
introduction of political or regulated-donation support
introduction of any value-adjusted destination comparison

aggregationPolicy.overlapHandling: A verified resource, action, signer, or deliverable may appear in multiple explanatory views, but may enter an additive platform aggregate at most once. Direct causal attribution and cooperative allocation are alternative attribution lenses and are never summed. Currency, count, duration, and value-adjusted quantities remain separate unless an independently approved immutable conversion snapshot exists.

parameters.publicationRule: withhold modeled components unless exact-hash model approval and current health pass exist
